name: League Desktop (noVNC)
description: A lightweight X desktop (TigerVNC + fluxbox) viewable in the browser through noVNC on port 6080. Supervised, with a websocket heartbeat and an auto-reconnecting client.

resolution.description: Initial desktop size, WIDTHxHEIGHT. Can be overridden at runtime with the DESKTOP_RESOLUTION environment variable.

depth.description: Color depth of the virtual display.

webPort.description: Port that serves the noVNC web client and websocket.

heartbeat.description: Seconds between websocket pings, so idle sessions aren't dropped by proxies.
